head: Fituous calorie tracker app keeps food, water and fasting in one place
dek: Fituous is a new calorie and nutrition tracker for iPhone and iPad that puts your food diary, macros, water, fasting and weight in one view and works local-first. It was #47 in Health & Fitness on the US App Store's paid chart on 13 November.
details: A goal wizard suggests a daily calorie target and macro split you can edit. You log food by searching Open Food Facts and USDA FoodData Central, scanning a barcode or speaking a phrase; speech runs on the device and you review each line before it's logged. It also has a fasting timer with 16:8, 18:6, 20:4 or custom plans. It costs 4.99 dollars, is made by Joshua Ludahl and came out on 8 November.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, 4.99 dollars
means: If you track calories, water and fasting in separate apps, this one puts them together, with on-device voice logging.
todo: Check the listing's features against what you track now before you pay.
